daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنا﴾ inna and its noun, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿نُوحاً﴾ its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى قَوْمِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَنْ أَنْذِرْ﴾ an explicative particle (ḥarf tafsīr), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿قَوْمَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is explicative (mufassira), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿أَنْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an, and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the interpreted maṣdar formed from an and the verb is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation.

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ إِنِّي﴾ the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person, and the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and inna and its noun. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). ﴿نَذِيرٌ﴾ khabar of inna. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the nominal clause is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an is an explicative particle (ḥarf tafsīr), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is explicative (mufassira), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ﴾ both conjoined (maʿṭūf) to اعبدوا.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿يَغْفِرْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the response to the request, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ ذُنُوبِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the verb, and they function as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ﴾ inna and its noun, annexed to the Name of Majesty. ﴿إِذا جاءَ﴾ إذا is a conditional adverb of time that does not make jussive, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation. ﴿لا يُؤَخَّرُ﴾ negative, and a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position; إذا together with its protasis and apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a conditional particle that does not make jussive. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause «كنتم..» is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:5-6.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, omitted for lightness; the vocative clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ﴾ inna and its noun, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿قَوْمِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿لَيْلًا﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿وَنَهاراً﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ليلا. ﴿فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the hāʾ is its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿دُعائِي﴾ a postponed fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿فِراراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun. ﴿كُلَّما دَعَوْتُهُمْ﴾ كلما is a conditional particle that does not make jussive, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation. ﴿لِتَغْفِرَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of purpose (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied an and the verb is in the position of a genitive by the lām, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb تغفر. ﴿جَعَلُوا أَصابِعَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي آذانِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb, and they stand in the place of the second object; the verbal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاسْتَغْشَوْا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to جعلوا. ﴿ثِيابَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَصَرُّوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا﴾ conjoined to استغشوا. ﴿اسْتِكْباراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

daas-irab:8-9.t: ﴿ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُهُمْ﴾ thumma is a conjunction, and inna and its noun, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جِهاراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِنِّي أَعْلَنْتُ﴾ inna and its noun, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ﴾ conjoined to أعلنت لهم. ﴿إِسْراراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq.

daas-irab:10-11.t: ﴿فَقُلْتُ﴾ the fāʾ is a resumptive particle, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿اسْتَغْفِرُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna [and] its noun. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir). ﴿غَفَّاراً﴾ khabar (predicate) of kāna; the verbal clause is the khabar of inna, and the nominal clause is causal (taʿlīl), with no grammatical position. ﴿يُرْسِلِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿السَّماءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِدْراراً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the response to the request, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَيُمْدِدْكُمْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يرسل, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِأَمْوالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَبَنِينَ﴾ conjoined to أموال. ﴿وَيَجْعَلْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَيَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ أَنْهاراً﴾ parsed like the preceding one.

daas-irab:13-14.t: ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لا تَرْجُونَ﴾ lā is negative, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَقاراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is of ḥāl. ﴿قَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq), and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَطْواراً﴾ ḥāl; the clause is a ḥāl clause.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَوْا﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سَماواتٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿طِباقاً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of سبع; the clause خلق stands in place of the two objects of تروا.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿وَجَعَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿الْقَمَرَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِيهِنَّ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿نُوراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it, and what follows it is conjoined to it.

daas-irab:17-18.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَنْبَتَكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿نَباتاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ﴾ thumma is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ﴾ conjoined to يعيدكم. ﴿إِخْراجاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq.

daas-irab:19-20.t: ﴿وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿بِساطاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿لِتَسْلُكُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied an after the lām of purpose (taʿlīl), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied an and the verb is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to جعل. ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سُبُلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِجاجاً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); فجاجا means wide.

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿قالَ نُوحٌ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, omitted for lightness. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي﴾ inna and its noun, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the vocative clause with what follows it is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مَنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿لَمْ يَزِدْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مالُهُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَوَلَدُهُ﴾ conjoined to ماله. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿خَساراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of من.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وَمَكَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مَكْراً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿كُبَّاراً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿لا تَذَرُنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil, and the nūn is for emphasis. ﴿آلِهَتَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلا تَذَرُنَّ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَدًّا﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and what follows it is conjoined to it.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is of ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا﴾ qad is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq), and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَلا تَزِدِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lā, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ضَلالًا﴾ second mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿مِمَّا﴾ min is a preposition. ﴿ما﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿خَطِيئاتِهِمْ﴾ genitive (majrūr) by min, and the preposition with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) what follows them. ﴿أُغْرِقُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَأُدْخِلُوا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to أغرقوا. ﴿ناراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ من دون is a ḥāl (circumstantial), and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْصاراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿وَقالَ نُوحٌ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿رَبِّ لا تَذَرْ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, omitted for lightness, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lā, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَى الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنَ الْكافِرِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿دَيَّاراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the vocative clause and the verbal clause are the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿إِنْ تَذَرْهُمْ﴾ in is a conditional particle that makes jussive, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يُضِلُّوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿عِبادَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis, with no grammatical position, and the condition and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of إنك, and the nominal clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلا يَلِدُوا﴾ lā is negative, and an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿فاجِراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَفَّاراً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿رَبِّ اغْفِرْ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yāʾ of the first person, omitted for lightness, and a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ) whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَلِوالِدَيَّ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to لي. ﴿وَلِمَنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, also conjoined [to it]. ﴿دَخَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بَيْتِيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مُؤْمِناً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِناتِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَلا تَزِدِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lā, whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿تَباراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.
